001package com.streamConverter.path;
002
003/**
004 * Base interface for type-safe path representations.
005 *
006 * <p>This interface provides a contract for different types of path selectors used in
007 * StreamConverter commands, such as JSONPath, XPath, and CSV column selectors.
008 *
009 * <p>Path implementations should validate their syntax at construction time and provide meaningful
010 * error messages for invalid paths.
011 */
012public interface IPath {
013
014  /**
015   * Validates the path syntax and throws an exception if invalid.
016   *
017   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the path syntax is invalid
018   */
019  void validate();
020
021  /**
022   * Returns the string representation of the path.
023   *
024   * @return the path as a string
025   */
026  String getPath();
027
028  /**
029   * Returns the type of this path for identification purposes.
030   *
031   * @return the path type (e.g., "JSONPath", "XPath", "CSVPath")
032   */
033  String getType();
034
035  /**
036   * Checks if this path is equivalent to another path.
037   *
038   * @param other the other path to compare with
039   * @return true if the paths are equivalent, false otherwise
040   */
041  boolean isEquivalentTo(IPath other);
042}
